name: greek_letter_successor
description: Continue the Greek alphabet: given two consecutive Greek letter names, give the next. Control repeats the last given letter.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
G=['alpha','beta','gamma','delta','epsilon','zeta','eta','theta','iota','kappa','lambda','mu','nu','xi','omicron','pi','rho','sigma','tau','upsilon','phi','chi','psi','omega']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
    j=random.randrange(len(G)-2)
    items.append({"prompt":f"Greek alphabet in order: {G[j]}, {G[j+1]}, and the next letter is","answer":" "+G[j+2]})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Greek alphabet in order: {G[j]}, {G[j+1]}. The last letter written was","answer":" "+G[j+1]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
